**Grant Application: Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)**

**Organization:** Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)
**Grantor:** Everytown Safety Fund
**Request Amount:** $50,000 - $200,000

Gun violence disproportionately impacts communities of color in Sacramento, necessitating culturally competent, grassroots solutions. Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) is a minority-owned social enterprise uniquely positioned to address this critical need through innovative gun safety education.

As a trusted voice within the communities we serve, GAFC possesses unparalleled cultural competency, fostering an environment where sensitive topics can be discussed openly. Our programs, developed in partnership with the Church of Legacy, deliver comprehensive education. "Gloxsie 21" leverages engaging animation to teach youth responsible firearm interaction, while our AI education initiative equips adults with knowledge on smart gun technology and secure storage solutions. Hands-on community workshops provide practical safety protocols, fostering a culture of responsible gun ownership.

With Everytown's support, GAFC will significantly increase gun safety knowledge, reduce accidental shootings, and empower families to create safer homes. A $50,000-$200,000 investment will enable us to expand program reach, develop more educational content, and strengthen our community engagement, directly contributing to Everytown’s mission of ending gun violence.
